svg.title: Trellis architecture: the rings and their projects
svg.desc: A bento of the rings of a default Trellis solution, each project a card holding its folders and files: Presentation (Api, Api.Common, Api.Contracts, UI.Common, UI.Web); Infrastructure and Persistence, peers that never reference each other; Application; Domain and SharedKernel; Shared (ServiceDefaults) and tools (AppHost, MigrationService, Analyzers). Arrows show references, all pointing inward. The Invoices slice is expanded in every project that has it.
svg.text: Projects and folders, ring by ring
Every project a default dotnet new trellis generates, in its ring, with its real folders; every reference points inward.
driving adapters: the HTTP API and the Blazor UI
driven adapters: JWT, e-mail, outbound HTTP
driven adapters: EF Core, Identity, the outbox
